description: Retrieve details of a specific asynchronous operation for the company. Available to the operation's creator and company admins. For company-readable operation types (for example `bulk_create_and_initialize_projects`), any company member may read the operation, receiving a restricted payload that omits `result`, `error`, `created_by_id`, and `sub_operations`.

data.description: Asynchronous operation details for show responses, including sub-operations when present.

operation_type.description: Kind of asynchronous work this operation performs.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the operation started. Null if it has not started.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the operation finished. Null if it has not completed.

error.description: Failure details when the operation failed. Null otherwise.

result.description: Operation-specific result. See the initiating API for the result format.

context.description: Opaque internal context for the operation.

created_by_id.description: Login information ID of the user who created the operation.

project_id.description: ID of the project the operation belongs to, if any.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent operation, if this operation is a child of a batch operation

failure_details.description: Why this operation failed, when the failure was recorded with a reason. Populated for rows of a bulk create that were rejected before a project was attempted, or that failed while initializing. Nul...

submitted_row.description: Values submitted for this row, keyed by bulk-create template column. Restricted to the name and project_number columns for readers who are neither the operation creator nor a company admin.

row_index.description: Zero-based position of this row in the original bulk-create upload. Present on failed create_and_initialize_project children so clients can label the row and restore upload order. Children are not ...

progress.description: Progress summary for parent operations that fan out into child operations. Only populated for bulk-create parent operations.

total.description: Total number of child operations (submitted rows), capped at 100

successful.description: Number of child operations whose base project was successfully initialized

failed.description: Number of child operations that failed validation or base initialization

in_progress.description: Number of child operations still in progress

percentage.description: Percentage of successful base-project initializations (successful / total * 100)

sub_operations.description: Child sub-operations that make up this operation, when present.

items.description: Child unit of work within a parent asynchronous operation.
